findings: All four lanes completed their original 43 exact native selectors; those subset receipts are independently audited in pq-controls-phase-analysis.json.
Complete-library x64 head and merge each passed 934 tests with 23 ignored. Complete-library ARM head and merge each passed 932, failed the same 2 original large-parent CPU gates, and ignored 23.
All four complete-library runs passed the two new diagnostic helper tests. All four strict Clippy commands independently failed the known redundant_closure_call in the cfg(test) observation macro.
Both ARM tests panic at detached_admission/tests.rs:724, result.native.unwrap(), with PublicMutationCpuBudget / Capacity / PUBLIC_MUTATION_CPU_BUDGET. The outer attempt.unwrap() already succeeded.

dispatch_shared_with_metered_w1 obtains the native result, then operation.finish settles the CPU tail, then returns Ok(MeteredWorkFactOutcome { native, cpu }). The outer Ok does not assert native success, and finish does not rewrite the native Result.

The original test only reads active-state equality if the OUTER attempt is Err. These four auth samples therefore record null equality. Durable admission/publication or active-state outcome cannot be inferred from that null.

The original 2-second burst, 0.25-second-per-second refill, 0.1-second start reserve, worker limit 2 and held schedule remain; all four auth samples have measured negative final paid credit and PUBLIC_MUTATION_CPU_BUDGET.

Each failing auth operation has 10 complete_commitment calls and 10 nested complete_state_root calls, 7 persisted_state_root calls, and 6 account_graph calls. Inclusive/nested stage CPU must not be summed as disjoint costs.
All observed clocks are known in these emitted stage deltas; absence of a more precise refusal checkpoint still prevents assigning the failure to one exact Host callback.

No independent fixture logic defect is established by these artifacts. Preserve the strict original acceptance assertion; optimize measured repeated complete-state encoding/math within the original budget and rerun only a new reviewed candidate through its original gates.
measurement_limits: These samples are independent of root's workspace CPU artifact set and are not pooled with its 2.686-2.725-second ARM measurements.
No executable content digest was supplied by the archived build/run receipts; source/tree, compiler, Cargo profile and exact executable path are preserved.
Full-library diagnostics reached the fixed process log cap once in each lane; that limit is not a pass/fail result and does not suppress the test summaries or these CPU JSON records.
All 43 exact controls passing does not establish stable wall-deadline margin, full-suite success, whole-chain security qualification or active-state rollback.
Successful ordinary-backend cases preceding the failing authenticated-backend cases are useful differentials, not randomized or isolated causal performance experiments.
The candidate string-value-pool optimization and macro lint fix are separate untested-by-these-artifacts source changes.
